definition: Estradiol is presented here as a sex-hormone-based adjunctive agent proposed for males with treatment-resistant bipolar disorder. In this framework, it is intended to act on brain estrogen receptors linked to neuroplasticity, inflammatory signaling, and stress response, with the goal of reducing mood instability and related cognitive or stress-related problems when buffered by a selective estrogen receptor modulator.
